create_even_splits: create evenly sized non-overlapping sub-splits of a TFDS dataset split with optional drop_remainder
create_split_for_jax_process: create a dataset subsplit for a specific JAX distributed process index and process count
test_even_splits: test the even_splits function to generate n non-overlapping sub-splits from a dataset split string
refactor_split_for_jax_process: refactor split_for_jax_process to accept explicit process_index and process_count parameters
review_even_split_class: review the _EvenSplit dataclass that represents a subsplit of a given split with index and count
